name: IronClaw Proof of Life
description: Verifies that IronClaw can execute a gateway tool via rj-tool and return real output. This is the simplest possible test: read a file and report its contents. Findings without tool evidence are automatically rejected.
process: You MUST use the exec tool to call rj-tool. Do NOT guess or fabricate file contents.
Execute: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/main.go"})
Read the output from the tool call. It will contain the file contents.
Report the first 5 lines of the file content exactly as returned by the tool.
Count the total number of 'func ' declarations in the file.
Report your findings with the exact line count and first 5 lines as evidence.

metrics.successCriteria: Agent returned actual file content from github_fetch tool call, verifiable against gateway audit log
